say:1:1631013001:0.text: Uh, yeah... it's just so fun to watch—people gliding like they're weightless!
say:1:1631013001:0.source_cn: 呃，嗯……是的，因为人们在冰上滑行的样子太有意思啦！
say:1:1631013001:0.male: Uh, yeah... it's just so fun to watch—people gliding like they're weightless!
say:1:1631013001:0.female: Uh, yeah... it's just so fun to watch—people gliding like they're weightless!

say:2:1631013002:0.text: We snowfolk... we're not built for twirls or leaps or anything remotely graceful.
say:2:1631013002:0.source_cn: 我们雪人可没法做出那么多有趣的动作。
say:2:1631013002:0.male: We snowfolk... we're not built for twirls or leaps or anything remotely graceful.
say:2:1631013002:0.female: We snowfolk... we're not built for twirls or leaps or anything remotely graceful.

say:3:1631013003:0.text: They say some people glide so beautifully that it's like the ice itself starts to sing beneath their feet.
say:3:1631013003:0.source_cn: 而且，我听说有人能滑得很漂亮，就好像在冰面跳舞一样。
say:3:1631013003:0.male: They say some people glide so beautifully that it's like the ice itself starts to sing beneath their feet.
say:3:1631013003:0.female: They say some people glide so beautifully that it's like the ice itself starts to sing beneath their feet.

say:4:1631013004:0.text: I'd give anything to see that kind of magic again...
say:4:1631013004:0.source_cn: 好想再看一次这样的冰上舞蹈啊……
say:4:1631013004:0.male: I'd give anything to see that kind of magic again...
say:4:1631013004:0.female: I'd give anything to see that kind of magic again...
